regulator.name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facet_hints.registration: Kenya requires registration of data controllers and processors with the ODPC subject to thresholds; confirm the current thresholds and exemptions.
facet_hints.dpia: Confirm when a data protection impact assessment is mandatory under the Act and the 2021 Regulations.
facet_hints.cross_border: Confirm the conditions for transfer outside Kenya, including the data-localisation requirements for certain categories.
facet_hints.breach_notification: Confirm the notification period to the Commissioner and the threshold for notifying data subjects.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search ODPC determinations and penalty notices — Kenya publishes these and they are the best available enforcement evidence in the region.

seed_obligations.provision: Registration of data controllers and processors
seed_obligations.title: Register with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner where the threshold is met
applies_when: processes personal data of individuals in Kenya above the prescribed threshold
testable_as: evidence of ODPC registration or a recorded threshold assessment

seed_obligations.title: Carry out a DPIA for high-risk processing
testable_as: a DPIA document covering the identified high-risk processing

seed_obligations.title: Notify the Commissioner of a personal data breach within the statutory period
testable_as: an incident runbook with the statutory deadline

seed_obligations.provision: Transfer of personal data outside Kenya
seed_obligations.title: Meet the conditions for transferring personal data outside Kenya
